description: Are federal offices open today? Returns the US Office of Personnel Management's current operating status for the federal government in the Washington, DC area (open, delayed arrival, early departure, closed, unscheduled leave or telework allowed, or a lapse in appropriations), with the date it applies to and OPM's guidance for employees. Useful for federal workers, contractors and visitors on snow days and funding deadlines. It covers the DC area only; agencies elsewhere set their own local status, and it does not cover individual agency closures. (cost: 1 credit)
name: us_government_operating_status
